key_insight: WorldCrafter introduces a camera-queryable implicit 3D-aware memory so a video world model can preserve and retrieve prior observations from different viewpoints. Instead of treating memory as generic context, it conditions compression on the requested view, improving long-horizon and multi-view consistency.
problem_solved: The paper tackles the common failure of video world models to stay consistent with earlier observations over time and across changing camera viewpoints. Existing models often forget important details or cannot correctly reconstruct what was seen from another angle.
method: Learn an implicit 3D-aware memory that can be queried by camera pose/viewpoint.
Use the requested viewpoint to guide how multi-view evidence is compressed into the limited token budget of the video generator.
Train the memory encoder, pose-conditioning module, and video generator jointly so memory retrieval and video prediction work together.
impact: This makes video world models more reliable for interactive simulation, embodied AI, and viewpoint-aware video generation. For practitioners, it offers a path to generate scenes that remain coherent over long horizons without requiring dense explicit 3D reconstruction.

paper_title: WorldCrafter: Consistent Video World Model with Implicit 3D-aware Memory
